# Chat dependencies

These browser distributions are pinned and embedded in `botd`. Refresh each
asset and its license together from the matching npm release.

| Local file | Package and version | Upstream file |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `marked.js` | [marked 18.2.1](https://www.npmjs.com/package/marked/v/18.2.1) | `lib/marked.umd.js` |
| `purify.js` | [dompurify 3.4.18](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dompurify/v/3.4.18) | `dist/purify.min.js` |
| `highlight.js` | [@highlightjs/cdn-assets 11.12.0](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@highlightjs/cdn-assets/v/11.12.0) | `highlight.min.js` |
